description: Look up one Treasury security by CUSIP: its terms, price history, and analytics including duration, convexity, DV01 and key-rate durations, plus TIPS and floating-rate analytics where they apply, and the amount outstanding. Takes a CUSIP, not a description such as 'the current 10-year'.

outstanding_on.description: Date for the amount outstanding. The month-end statement in force on it is used. Defaults to today.

summarize.description: True drops the daily price and analytics series and keeps the latest values. Use it unless you need the full history — a 30-year bond carries thousands of rows.

name: get_treasury_security
title: Look up a Treasury security
